syntheticInputs.code: One synthetic valid 43-character token made from repeated a; no real capability.
syntheticInputs.initialView: Minimal synthetic current HTML with correct media/timing/digest metadata for the injected export bytes.

exportResponse.bodyDescription: Synthetic receipt-shaped JSON with an intentionally oversized padding string.

syntheticInputs.stream: Actual Node Web-standard Response and ReadableStream, producing at most 65536 bytes per chunk with normal ReadableStream prefetch, without a socket or server.
syntheticInputs.clock: Fixed wall and monotonic clocks during completed reads; scheduled callbacks are not advanced. This is a byte-budget witness, not a latency test.

observed.statusMessage: Receipt format could not be verified. Enter your access token to try again.

limitations: Actual receipt client runs in a Node VM with a minimal synthetic DOM, initial HTML and injected transport.
The client stops after the first delivered chunk that would exceed the 262144-byte accumulator, cancels the stream before EOF and rejects without parsing, hashing or download.
The production handler emits bounded canonical JSON. This witness injects an unexpected oversized response, not an ordinary handler output or authorization bypass.
An actual ReadableStream may prefetch beyond the last client-delivered chunk. Produced bytes and delivered bytes are reported separately, not claimed as heap or browser memory bounds.
No browser, HTTP server, live network, database, credentials, payment or provider is used.
The baseline in turn045 consumed 394831 bytes to EOF with Response.blob and no stream cancellation. This after-change witness uses the same payload and 65536-byte chunks.
